info.name: Railway System - G2 Passenger & User Management
info.description:
Group 2 requests for the National Railway Reservation & Management System.

HOW TO RUN: (1) start MySQL + the Spring Boot backend on port 8080 with the seed data loaded; (2) run the folder 'Auth setup' first; (3) run the remaining folders in order (Collection Runner). Registration creates a fresh account on every run; Account lockout locks only that account.

Assumes app.auth.require-login-otp=false and app.auth.dev-mode=true (defaults in application.yml). The last folder needs db/60_demo_data.sql.
